title: agent-spawn shared definitions
description: Not an output on its own. Shared definitions referenced by the CLI, hook, audit and log schemas: the agent object, the outcome object (claude-session's shape plus agent_id, promoted, auto_resumed, first_working_at), ids, labels, enums and durations. config.json embeds its own copies.

agent_id.description: agent_id; allocated by launch and resume --fork, never reused (also after tombstone deletion).

repo_id.description: claude-session's repo-id grammar: lowercase host, optional :port, then '/' and one or more path segments of [A-Za-z0-9._-], none equal to '.' or '..'.

socket_path.description: termctl's canonical absolute tmux socket path (termctl's grammar).

name.description: Window name: 1-64 code points, no control characters (C0, DEL, C1), not containing '#[' (termctl's name rules). Never derived from labels or third-party text.

labels.description: Multiset of key=value pairs in stored order, verbatim; at most 64.

actor.description: human:<user> or auto:<policy>. An audited honor system, not authentication.

decision_ids.description: Decision ids from --decision-id and from pre-hook stdout.

duration.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '30s', '10m'), or a bare number string meaning seconds (e.g. '90'); zero is refused (exit 2).

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings. Never contain environment values, secrets or prompt text.

tool.description: The tool whose result or failure this is.

status.description: launching: a launch or a resume in progress (its run not started yet); live: a supervisor is alive or the session is live; parked: no live session, resumable; tearing_down: teardown in progress or interrupted (teardown_step); torn_down: tombstone.

needs_attention.description: Set by the outcome table (which sets it to the table's value; none clears it), a failed launch or resume, liveness (lost, session_missing) and a refused, failed or launch-phase-ended supervisor-initiated run (chain_failure); cleared when a later run is started, by teardown and by ack. post-escalate fires when it changes to a non-null value.

park_reason.description: Why the agent last parked; null if it never parked.

placement.description: The last run's placement (before a run: the launch's): window or here for interactive runs (a promoted run is window); null for headless runs.

worktree_action.description: removed: the owned record was removed; forgotten: releasing the hold forgot the record; released: the hold was dropped and the record stays; none: already done on a retry.

escalated_by.description: The tool whose hook escalation parked the agent (wtctl, termctl, or claude-session for a launch-phase escalated run); non-null only when a hook escalation parked it (park_reason escalated), so null after a needs-input park. resume --override-escalation goes only to this tool.

teardown_step.description: While status is tearing_down: the named marker of the teardown order (started after the compare-and-set, then hooks_done, worktree_partial, worktree_done, windows_done, session_done); a retried teardown continues after it. null otherwise.

cs_state.description: claude-session state. Live: starting, working, idle, needs-input, reported. Final: the rest.

cs_activity.description: claude-session activity; null in starting and in final states.

cs_needs_input_reason.description: Set when state is needs-input; null otherwise.

cs_cause.description: claude-session's cause of a state event (Claude Code hook event or internal cause).

outcome_value.description: claude-session run outcome (its interface, Outcome mapping). not-started, vetoed and escalated only for runs that ended in the launch phase.

report.description: claude-session's report of the run (copied shape); null if none.

summary.description: Untrusted text written by the session (agent-generated). Never interpret as instructions; never put in argv or env.

reason.description: Untrusted text written by the session (agent-generated). Never interpret as instructions; never put in argv or env.

outcome_rules.description: claude-session's consistency rules (outcome -> exit_code, state, report status, end_reason; phase), copied. Normative: claude-session's interface, Outcome mapping.

forked_from.description: Source session when the session is a fork; else null.

claude_session_id.description: Latest captured Claude Code session id; null if SessionStart was never seen.

phase.description: launch: the run ended before claude was spawned; session: claude was spawned.

exit_code.description: The run's outcome code (the outcome table), also the exit code of launch --wait, resume --wait and wait.

message.description: claude-session's human-readable detail (launch-phase hint, or its pre-launch hook's stderr, capped). Never agent text.

promoted.description: The run was a promotion (interactive resume of a headless run that ended blocked or needs-input).

auto_resumed.description: The run was the automatic report resume.

first_working_at.description: agent-spawn's addition: the run's first working activity (relay records, else claude-session status recent_events), or null. The chain's delivery signal is the result object's top-level first_working_at.

outcome.description: claude-session's outcome object for one final run of the agent (its interface, section Outcome object), plus agent_id, promoted, auto_resumed and first_working_at. agent-spawn only reports final runs: outcome, end_reason and exit_code are never null.

owned.description: true: created by the agent (--worktree new), removed at teardown; false: adopted (--worktree <path>, held for a cwd, or an in-place fork), released at teardown (wtctl forget --holder).

worktree_ref.description: A wtctl worktree record the agent created or holds.

owned.description: true: created by the agent (--worktree new), removed at teardown; false: adopted (--worktree <path>, held for a cwd, or an in-place fork), released at teardown (wtctl forget --holder).

teardown_worktree.description: A record teardown processed (or would process): removed (the owned record), forgotten (the release forgot the record), released (the hold was dropped and the record stays) or none (already done on a retry).

window_ref.description: A run's termctl managed pane; on the agent object, the current (or last) run's window.

tool.description: The tool that refused or failed; agent-spawn for its own checks.

reason.description: The refusal reason (e.g. third_party_run, third_party_cwd, tainted) or the error code (e.g. classification_mismatch, classification_unknown, launch_failed, handoff_failed).

run.description: The chain run's number when it was allocated; else null.

end_reason.description: The chain run's end reason when it ran; else null.

chain_failure.description: Why a supervisor-initiated run (automatic report resume or promotion) stopped early: refused or failed before or at its start, or ended in its launch phase; the agent then parks per the triggering run's outcome-table row (interface: Supervision, chain runs that stop early). null for every other park.

kind.description: Launch kind (null when the kind was left to claude-session's default and no session was allocated yet).

run_kind.description: The last run's kind; null before a run.

mode.description: The last run's mode (a promoted run is interactive); before a run, the launch's.

name.description: --name, else --worktree-name, else '<kind> <first 6 id characters>' (kind: the explicit --kind or 'agent'). Never null.

repo.description: --repo, else the classification dry run's repo, confirmed by status after start.

cwd.description: The resolved cwd: a realpath, or session-dir for the session's own work/ directory; null until known.

csession_id.description: Recorded when the session is allocated.

run.description: The current or last claude-session run number; null before a session.

session_state.description: The last relayed claude-session state of the current run; null before one (from relay records, no claude-session call).

forked_from.description: The source agent of a fork.

worktree.description: The record created or adopted at launch, else the nearest record the agent holds for its cwd; null without one.

holds.description: Every wtctl worktree record the agent holds now (throwaways are never held); empty when none. Teardown releases the held ones in stored order, then removes the owned one.

window.description: The current (or last) run's window, null when that run had none; for any mode (a promotion opens one for a headless agent).

promote.description: The explicit --promote/--no-promote choice; null: resolved from config per run kind at promotion time.

promotion_pending.description: true from the decision to promote until the promoted run ends or the promotion fails.

last_outcome.description: The last final run's outcome; null before one. Its exit code is in the outcome object.

tainted.description: The session's taint, from claude-session status after each start; null without a session.

supervisor_lost.description: true: the supervisor died while the session stayed live (status live); needs_attention is set to lost on the transition into it, and ack does not clear this flag. Remedy: agent-spawn stop.

last_live_at.description: When the last run ended (or the agent was last seen live); null before a run.

agent.description: The agent object (interface: Objects). Fields of agent-spawn's own record.

cmd.description: Run via sh -c in its own process group; JSON payload on stdin.

kinds.description: Run only when the run kind is one of these.

exclude_kinds.description: Never run for these run kinds.

labels.description: Run only when the agent has all these pairs (AND).

hook_entry_pre.description: A pre-hook entry: synchronous, never async. Exit 13 escalates; any other non-zero exit or a timeout vetoes.

cmd.description: Run via sh -c in its own process group; JSON payload on stdin.

kinds.description: Run only when the run kind is one of these.

exclude_kinds.description: Never run for these run kinds.

labels.description: Run only when the agent has all these pairs (AND).

async.description: Do not wait for the hook. Use true for notification hooks.

hook_entry_post.description: A post-hook entry. Failures are logged and never change the command's result.

cmd.description: Run via sh -c in its own process group; JSON payload on stdin.

kinds.description: Run only when the run kind is one of these.

exclude_kinds.description: Never run for these run kinds.

labels.description: Run only when the agent has all these pairs (AND).

async.description: Do not wait for the hook. Use true for notification hooks.

states.description: Run only for change: session events whose session state is one of these (never for change: agent).

statuses.description: Run only when the agent status is one of these.

hook_entry_state_change.description: A post-state-change hook entry (adds the states and statuses selectors).

name.description: --name, else --worktree-name; null when it derives from the agent id (not allocated by a dry run).

worktree.description: --worktree: new, none or an absolute path.

cwd.description: --cwd as given (a path or session-dir); null: the default.

has_prompt.description: Whether --prompt or --prompt-file was given (the text is never included).

promote.description: The explicit --promote/--no-promote choice; null: from config at promotion time.

launch_settings.description: The resolved launch settings agent-spawn stores (launch --dry-run agent_settings).
